name: Coursebox LMS
description: Coursebox LMS is an AI-Driven Learning Management System for Rapid Course Deployment with native Coursebox AI and community engagement functionality.

events.n: Invite and Enroll User to a Course
events.d: Invite and enroll a user into a selected course, setting email, name, role, headline, terms, and custom fields.
Update the action response to return a confirmation message when the Coursebox API reports success.
Add a user as a follower of a selected group (Channel). Joining a group does not enrol the user in the courses inside it.
Remove a user from a selected group. Course enrolments taken via the group remain intact.
Set one or more custom fields for a user by field ID and value; optionally specify a user ID.
Update a user's profile attributes. Omit the user ID to update the API key owner's profile.
Fetch learners enrolled in a selected course.
